known_at_writing: Pooled validation (2015-2024) and holdout (2025+2026) metrics already committed in validation_receipt.json (validation log loss 0.60498; holdout 0.61082).
The committed holdout slice with 3-5 minimum current games: n=45, log loss 0.7132, Brier 0.25896, accuracy 0.4889, AUC 0.5751. This is HOLDOUT data and is never used to choose K.
not_known_at_writing: Any per-bin or cumulative validation metric, and any holdout metric other than the committed 3-5 slice.

measure.name: min_current_season_final_games
measure.definition: m = min(home_n_current, away_n_current): each team's final, box-complete, current-season (type 2 or 3) games visible under the frozen as-of rule (started before as_of = tip - 15 min and on an earlier ET date). Same numbers the frozen feature build emits (dataset_k4_r0.6.csv columns home_n_current / away_n_current).

predictions.recipe: frozen v1 recipe exactly as scripts/model/walkforward.py: dataset k=4 r=0.6, feature set F_sos_form_situation_rotation, window last8, C=10, structural home term, trained per target season on ELIGIBLE rows (m >= 3) of prior seasons only.
predictions.scored_games: ALL games of the target season in the dataset, including m = 0-2 (currently NO CALL by the frozen eligibility floor), so the study can see what the model would have said.

metrics.cumulative: m >= K for K in 0..13: n, coverage %, log_loss, brier, ece

decision_rule.search: K is the SMALLEST integer in 0..13 satisfying (a), (b) and (c) on VALIDATION seasons only.
decision_rule.a_bins_beat_home_rate: Partition m >= K into bins: [K, upper edge of the fixed bin containing K], then each subsequent fixed bin (6-8, 9-12, 13+). Any bin with n < 60 is merged upward into the next bin before judging (the last bin, if < 60, merges downward). Every resulting bin must have model log loss strictly below the home_rate baseline log loss on the same games.
decision_rule.b_cumulative_calibration: The cumulative slice m >= K must have calibration slope within [0.80, 1.25] and ECE <= 0.050.
decision_rule.c_entry_slice_floor: The entry slice K <= m <= K+2 must have log loss < 0.660. If that slice has n < 60 it is extended upward one game-count at a time until n >= 60.
decision_rule.floor_justification: 0.660 sits between the pooled validation log loss (0.605) and a coin flip (0.693): an entry slice at or above it is too close to a guess to publish as a model call. Chosen before any bin metric was computed.
decision_rule.no_k: If no K in 0..13 satisfies all three, the study reports FAIL and proposes no threshold; the honest consequence is stated in the doc.

contract_mapping.reason: The frozen v1 policy already publishes NO CALL below 3 current games (feature_spec.json, fixed before holdout). This study may only tighten that floor, never loosen it.

holdout_use: For the chosen K only: report holdout bin and cumulative metrics as confirmation. Holdout never changes K.
not_allowed: choosing K by reference to any specific upcoming game
changing bins, floors or thresholds after seeing validation or holdout bin metrics
